text: Teesta River White Water Rafting is a celebrated destination in East Sikkim, Sikkim, renowned for its nature, adventure, rivers. Located in the historic and scenic region of Sikkim, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Sikkim. The best time to plan a visit is generally March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
best_time: March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views)
